Question: ASSLAMUALAIKUM ! KYA FARMATE HAI BUZURGANE DEEN AUR SHARAI MATEEN MASLA HASBEAIL KAI BARE MAIN KI BINA KISI SHARAI UZHRA KE TAYUMMUM KARKE QURAN PADNA KAISA HAI? BARA E MEHARWANI ROSHNI DALE. Answer ID: 10877 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 195/42=TL/1430) In this state, you can recite the Quran without touching it, but it is unlawful to hold and touch it: لأن من جملتھا التیمم لمس المصحف ولا بشبھۃ في أنہ عند وجود الماء لا یصح أصلاً ( شامی 1:411 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
